comments.note: BookmarksPanelViewModel.cs line 161: the positional call site passed CancellationToken as the 6th arg. Inserting the new defaulted `videoPath` parameter at position 6 required switching to `ct: linked.Token` (named argument). This is a minor but real hazard: defaulted optional parameters inserted before an existing defaulted parameter silently break positional call sites. Pattern is consistent with the WP rationale but worth noting for future interface evolution.

FakeBookmarkSettingsService does not track the `hash` argument despite it being a call-tracking property peer of `LastMovieId`, `LastPositionMs`, etc. A future WP adding hash-based thumbnail assertions would need to add `LastHash`. Not in scope here — recorded for awareness.
